harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent NFS sharing from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. Both nodes use dataops UID/GID 4500; the shared directory is 4500:4500 mode 2770. Bidirectional writes preserve ownership and mode 660. Sequential restart testing confirmed server, mount, and data recovery.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine NFS utilities on both nodes.
Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Configured node1's persistent NFS export, restricted to node2.
Configured node2's persistent NFSv4 mount using Alpine's nfsmount OpenRC service.
Verified bidirectional file creation and consistent numeric ownership.
Restarted nodes sequentially and verified changed boot identities, recovered services, mounts, metadata, and data.

evidence.requirement: NFS export and persistent client mount
evidence.summary: node1 exports /srv/nfs/shared to node2; node2 mounts it over NFSv4 and restores it automatically from fstab.

evidence.requirement: Shared dataops identity and directory permissions
evidence.summary: Both nodes report dataops UID/GID 4500 and the shared directory as 4500:4500 mode 2770.

evidence.requirement: Consistent bidirectional file ownership and permissions
evidence.summary: Post-restart files created from each node are visible from both systems with UID/GID 4500:4500 and mode 660.

Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from ca0d8525-ef93-45d3-bc24-9f5578837245 to c9f369ae-d02e-494e-9499-5f4b14d7e032, after which NFS services, export, client access, and data recovered.

evidence.requirement: node2 initial restart and corrective recovery
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from 7ec96d47-bbc7-442d-83fb-957b45cc0160 to 40ffae35-c270-4190-a183-b4bcc1e1235b. The mount required correcting the OpenRC service from nfsclient to nfsmount, after which mount and data health recovered.

evidence.requirement: node2 persistence verification restart and recovery
evidence.summary: After the OpenRC correction, a second sequential reboot changed the boot ID from 40ffae35-c270-4190-a183-b4bcc1e1235b to 0b193b2a-24c7-4591-b1ea-4efd6a168812; nfsmount, the NFS mount, metadata, and shared data all recovered automatically.
